title: Protein Expression and Purification
author: Xuehua Wan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ikhcct6

steps.title: Transform E. coli Cells
steps.instruction: Transform His-tagged construction plasmids into BL21(DE3)pLysS or Rosetta(DE3)pLysS E. coli cells (Novagen).

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate colonies into 20 ml LB medium containing 100 μg/ml ampicillin and 34 μg/ml chloramphenicol and grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking.

steps.title: Scale Up Culture
steps.instruction: Transfer the starter culture into 1 L of fresh LB medium containing 100 μg/ml ampicillin and 34 μg/ml chloramphenicol.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Induce protein expression and enhance heme biosynthesis when the culture reaches OD600=0.5-0.6 at 37 °C with shaking (250 rpm).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 mg/L FeSO4·7H2O and 17 mg/L δ-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (ALA).

steps.title: Incubate Culture
steps.instruction: Further incubate the culture at either 37 °C for 3-4 hours or 30 °C for 6-8 hours.

steps.title: Harvest and Store Cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells by centrifugation at 5000 rpm and store at -20 °C prior to purification.

steps.title: Lyse and Prepare Sample
steps.instruction: Resuspend a cell pellet from 2 L of culture in 20 ml of buffer I (200 mM NaCl, 50 mM Na2HPO4, pH 8.0) containing 1mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride (PMSF) and sonicate.

substeps.instruction: Sonicate for 8 min using 24 pulses of 20 s with 20 s pauses (Sonic Dismembrator 550, Fisher Scientific).
Centrifuge the cell lysate to remove insoluble cell debris.
Filter the supernatant (0.22 μm pore size, Corning) and keep on ice until loading.

steps.title: Prepare Co2+ Resin Column
steps.instruction: Prepare the immobilized Co2+ resin column (POROS MC/20, 10 × 100 mm, column volume 7.9 ml) using the BioCAD SPRINT perfusion system (Applied Biosystems).

substeps.instruction: Wash with five column volumes (CV) of 50 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl (pH 8.0) at a flow rate of 15 ml/min.
Rinse with an equal volume of distilled water at 15 ml/min.
Load metal with 5 CV of 100 mM CoCl2·6H2O at 15 ml/min.
Wash with 5 CV of water at 15 ml/min.
Wash with 5 CV of 3 M NaCl at 15 ml/min to remove residual metal ions.

steps.title: Load Sample and Wash Column
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the column and load the protein sample.

substeps.instruction: Wash the column with 5 CV of buffer I containing 0.5 mM imidazole at a flow rate of 8.0 ml/min.
Load the sample onto the column at a flow rate of 0.5-1.0 ml/min.
Wash with 6-8 CV of buffer I at 2.0 ml/min.
Wash with 8 CV of buffer I containing 0.5 mM imidazole at 5.0 ml/min to remove non-specifically bound proteins.

steps.title: Elute Bound Proteins
steps.instruction: Elute the remaining bound proteins using a linear gradient of imidazole from 0.5 mM to 250 mM in buffer I.
